response.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT driverId, points, wins FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1.0), d AS (SELECT driverId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM f GROUP BY driverId), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_avg_wins FROM d) SELECT d.driverId, d.avg_points, d.avg_wins, d.avg_wins - m.mean_avg_wins AS wins_diff FROM d CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_avg_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (d.avg_wins - m.mean_avg_wins) IS NULL, (d.avg_wins - m.mean_avg_wins) DESC LIMIT 10;
